description: North Central Province - Road Transport Service Authority (Amendment) Statute No. 03. of 2013
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the amendment of a provincial statute (Road Transport Service Authority (Amendment) Statute No. 03 of 2013) and details new regulatory frameworks, penalty structures, and fee schedules for road transport operations. It falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it involves statutory instruments, regulatory amendments, and compliance requirements for transport services, without involving government personnel changes or structural reorganizations.
